desc:
🚀 READY TO FISH THE STARS? 
😎 Chill fishing in deep space ✨
🤯 Get SUPER RARE stars and galaxies

Upgrade your rods and explore different galaxies around the map. Cast your line into space to catch stars, then use them to craft items that boost your stats and help you progress faster.

Simple, relaxing, and fun! Space Fishing is all about upgrading, exploring, and seeing what you can pull from the universe.

✨ Upgrade rods!
🌠 Catch stars!
🛠️ Craft powerful items!

How many stars can you catch?

This game is in ALPHA, EXPECT BUGS AND CHANGES!
🐞 Please report any bugs you find in-game!
💡 If you have ideas for new content, new quests, or game balancing, please tell us!
